primitives.name: Path Segment Frequency Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: # wynnbet.com — crawl URLs reached: **17** ## Path segments | Segment | URLs | |---|---|
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{s}': 'frequency of path segment s in crawl data (dimensionless)', 'S': 'set of all path segments (finite set)'}
primitives.assumptions: Crawl data is representative; path segments are mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F_s = 0, segment is unreachable or misindexed.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic event space where each path segment is a hypothesis with frequency-derived prior probability.
layer2.telemetry: Crawl log entry count per segment

primitives.name: Canonical URL Structure Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: `https://wynnbet.com/` | Legal Online Sports Betting and Casino | WynnBET Sportsbook | | `https://www.wynnbet.com/` | Legal
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U_{c}': 'canonical URL identifier (string)', 'T': 'title tag associated with U_c (string)'}
primitives.assumptions: URLs with identical content have same canonical form; title tags reflect semantic intent.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When T is missing or malformed, structure is ambiguous.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSE's page state kernel by encoding URL semantics into navigational affordances.

primitives.name: Regional Navigation State Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Sportsbook | | `https://wynnbet.com/mi/` | Legal Online Sports Betting and Casino | WynnBET Sportsbook | |
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R': 'regional path identifier (e.g., mi, ny)', 'N_R': 'navigation count from root to R (integer)'}
primitives.assumptions: Each regional path corresponds to distinct user intent; N_R reflects traversal complexity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When N_R exceeds threshold, navigation may be suboptimal or redundant.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's state-action transition matrix where R represents a terminal state in a Markov chain.
layer2.telemetry: User session duration per regional path

Dualities emerge in that high-frequency segments may indicate core functionality, while low-frequency ones suggest niche or deprecated paths. Failure modes include zero-frequency segments indicating indexing errors or dead links, and inconsistent title tags suggesting content drift or SEO misalignment.
